features.notes: sunholo-data/ailang-packages PR #179 (branch sprint/mcp-oauth-0.2, head 88b49b0; not merged, not published), commit cde1a84. Per-client rotate (default) / stable (secret methods only, D3): no rotation, refresh_token omitted, 30d sliding idle capped at 180d absolute, client auth on every refresh; the used-flag check applies to both policies (a stable token is never marked used). revokeRequest (RFC 7009, always 200 after client auth; refresh token -> family, access token -> hooks.revoke; another client's token untouched).
